root_decision.text: Confirmed scoped correction: retain the native queue lock through dispatch/recycle, since the actual provider supports it and release is unnecessary. Preserve the sealed contract as historical input; append a hash-bound correction note linking this Root decision, native instructions and actual CCL lock evidence, and include it in HANDOFF limitations/remarks. Do not rewrite the original contract or native oracle to conceal the discrepancy. Validate observed lock order in replay.

reason: CCL PosixLock uses PTHREAD_MUTEX_RECURSIVE. Producer and consumer consistently take main then queue. Actual deferred dispatch has no queue dependency. No provider requirement justifies releasing queue before dispatch. Keeping both preserves native critical-section scope; unlike the discarded proposal, a future queue-only observer cannot acquire queue during dispatch. No source-level original interleaving or ARM ABI claim.
retry_condition: Revisit only if actual provider/deferred queue dependencies change; preserve native trace and this correction.
